runs.title: Scan history
runs.buildVersionHint: Version / commit of the platform deployment artifact that accepted this run (injected at image build time); container / sandbox runs execute there, while GitHub Action runs execute on the target repository runner. "Unknown" means it was not injected or the run predates this column
runs.environmentalFailuresHint: Environmental failures (killed by signal / timeout / silent non-zero exit) are not attributed to this run; shown for visibility
runs.verificationsSkippedHint: Verification did not run (budget exhausted / no writes in this run); not a failure and not a pass: budget skips block delivery, while no-write runs have nothing to deliver
runs.deliverySkippedHint: Install verification is still failing (pre-existing) after the fix, so the fix was not delivered (changes rolled back). Carriers (issue / draft PR) are only created by the engine fix-and-pr path via DEPENDFIX_ON_BASELINE_RED. Exit code is unaffected
runs.peakMemoryHint: Peak sampled cgroup memory.current during the run (includes page cache)
runs.oomKilledHint: Yes when the cgroup oom_kill counter increased during the run; null means unavailable
runs.unfixedAlertsHint: Alerts not fixed in this run (failed / skipped / not auto-fixable); not attributed as a regression from this run
runs.resultMissingHint: This run produced no result (e.g. execution timeout); no alert count is shown to avoid misreading it as zero alerts
